title: You set up a disposable mechanic test

steps.text: With dev=1, Pause offers Dev. The existing modal captures your controls while the island keeps running. Without the flag the Dev tools stay unloaded.
The selected tool loads on demand. Buttons and the typed agent API run the same bounded commands and return the same results.
A fresh solo place run gets its own room, scoped saves and a TEST badge. Travel and stage setup check the exact launched session and refuse shared rooms.
The report records build, setup, poses and command results. Its setup link asks before launching another disposable run; it is not an exact world replay.
